explanation: The statement is about the library's own definition `TauCeti.finiteMean`, which is `univ.centerMass (fun _ ↦ 1) z`. The proof merely unfolds `finiteMean_def` and the definition `Finset.centerMass` (`(∑ w)⁻¹ • ∑ w • z`) and simplifies `∑ 1 = card ι`, `1 • z i = z i`. Searching Mathlib for `finiteMean`, `centerMass` and for an average/expect lemma (`Finset.expect` in `Mathlib/Algebra/BigOperators/Expect.lean`, which needs a `ℚ≥0`-module and is a definition, not this identity) turns up no declaration stating `mean = (card ι)⁻¹ • ∑ i, z i`. The only Mathlib content used is the definition of `centerMass` plus generic `simp` lemmas (`sum_const`, `one_smul`), which do not constitute a Mathlib declaration of this result.
